description: The bar chart illustrates sentiment classification accuracy for two tweet subsets, comparing three annotation/sentiment methods. The horizontal axis contains two categories, “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet,” presented left to right, and the x-axis caption reads “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis.” The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy” and uses a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.8 with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.2 intervals. For “Emoji Tweets,” three adjacent bars are shown: a white bar with black outline labeled TEXTBLOB at approximately 0.33 accuracy, a white bar with diagonal hatching labeled VADER at approximately 0.45, and a solid green bar labeled ChatGPT at approximately 0.66–0.67. For “Overall Tweet,” the same three-bar grouping appears: TEXTBLOB (white with black outline) at about 0.38–0.40, VADER (white with diagonal hatching) at about 0.47–0.48, and ChatGPT (solid green) at about 0.65–0.66. The bars are grouped side-by-side within each category (not stacked), with a legend inside the plotting area identifying the three methods by fill style/color; the categories are not shown as sorted by value, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the distinct fill patterns and color.
